sentences.text:
Case :- Writ - C No. - 22334 of 2020
Petitioner :- Vinod Kumar Yadav

Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Yogendra Pati Tripathi Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Arun Kumar Gupta, learned Standing Counsel for the State-respondents.

The present writ petition has been preferred with following principal reliefs:-
"1) Issue a writ or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the respondents to forthwith give the protection of life and personal liberty from police personnel to the petitioner and thereafter relevant direction be also issued accordingly.
2) Issue a writ or direction in the nature of in the like of mandamus to conduct the enquiry by the C.B.I. or C.B.C.I.D. or judicial committee in this case."

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioner in support of his submission has placed reliance to the order dated 12.10.2020 passed by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court passed in Writ C No. 16018 of 2020 (Ankur Nishad and another Vs. State of U.P. and 3 others) wherein the following order has been passed:-
"This writ petition has been filed, inter-alia, for the following relief:
"I) Issue a writ or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondents to forthwith give protection of life and personal liberty from police-personnel to the petitioners, and thereafter relevant direction be also issued accordingly.
II) Issue, a writ or direction in the like of nature mandamus to conduct the enquiry by the C.B.I or C.B,C.I.D or Judicial Committee in this case.
III) Issue, a writ or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondents to forthwith decide the representation made by the petitioners before the respondents."

entities.text: Ankur Nishad and another Vs. State of U.P. and 3 others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, it is directed that in case petitioner is having any grievance with regard to fair investigation of the case the same may be raised before the Senior Superintendent of Police, Allahabad, who shall look into the matter and shall ensure fair and proper investigation in the matter so that it may reach to its logical conclusion one way or the other,
without any interference and without any fear.

With the above direction, the writ petition is disposed of. "
Learned counsel for the petitioner has vehemently contended that similar indulgence may also be extended in favour of the petitioner in view of Ankuar Nishad (supra).

On the other hand, learned Standing Counsel has opposed the writ petition and contended that admittedly the petitioner is an accused in Criminal Case No. 519 of 2019 (State v. Shiv Shanker Seth and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 91 of 2019, under Sections 34, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 487, 272 IPC and Section 60 of U.P.
Excise Act, Police Station Bada Gaon, District Varanasi wherein the chargesheet has already been submitted and cognizance has already been taken by the court concerned and the petitioner is on bail.

entities.text: Criminal Case No. 519 of 2019 (State v. Shiv Shanker Seth and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Police Station Bada Gaon, District Varanasi
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: We have occasion to peruse the record in question and find that while deciding the case of Ankuar Nishad (supra), the Court has directed for ensuring fair investigation in that matter but the petitioner in the aforesaid criminal case has already been chargesheeted, therefore, his case is distinguishable.

The record in question further reflects that the present matter was preferred in the year 2020 and since then Vinod Kumar Yadav vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169409553/
2 nothing has been brought on record to substantiate that at any point of time, he is being harassed by the local police.

entities.text: Vinod Kumar Yadav vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Under such facts and submissions, we are not inclined to entertain the present writ petition.
Accordingly, the writ petition stands dismissed.
